column4: Statewise distribution of Juvenile delinquency under the IPC (Table-37) shows that Maharashtra had the highest contribution of 27 per cent followed by Madhya Pradesh 22.3 per cent, contributing about 50 per cent of the total cases registered in the country. As against this, Uttar Pradesh, which is the largest populated state shared just 0.3 per cent. Among the UTs, Delhi alone registered 181 cases (77.7%) of the total cases registered in all the 7 UTs.
